item.title: Proxify AB: Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 Developer
item.description:
Headquarters: Sweden
URL: http://career.proxify.io

The Role:

 

We are looking for an expert Senior D365 Developer to act as a technical architect and lead developer across an enterprise Microsoft ecosystem for one of our clients. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in the technical development of Microsoft Dynamics 365 modules.
  • Strong proficiency in the Microsoft development stack—including X++, C#, .NET, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of the Dataverse environment, relational database design, and complex SQL/OData queries.
  • Extensive experience building and consuming REST/SOAP APIs and managing Data Entities.
  • Proven experience with Azure-hosted services and their interaction with the Dynamics 365 environment.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., PL-400, MB-500, or MB-400) are highly valued.
  • Intermediate-advanced English level.
  • Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the technical design and deployment of end-to-end solutions within the Dynamics 365 ecosystem.
  • Develop and maintain high-quality customizations (using X++ or C#/.NET) following "Clean Core" principles to ensure easy upgrades and maintainability.
  • Leverage Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven), Power Automate, and Dataverse to create low-code/pro-code hybrid solutions.
  • Architect and build secure integrations between D365 and external systems using Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, Azure Functions, and API Management).
  • Implement and extend Microsoft Copilot and AI-driven features to enhance business processes and data intelligence.
  • Oversee the Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) process using Azure DevOps, ensuring rigorous version control and automated deployment pipelines.



What we offer:

item.title: Ellipsis®: Strategy Lead (Remote, UK/EU -- £60-65k)
item.description:
Headquarters: Oxford, UK
URL: https://getellipsis.com

Ellipsis is fast becoming the market leader in "GEO" for B2B technology companies. This is a senior, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.

The move to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative and strategic in our approach. We started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, so this has been a time for us to thrive.

We think we understand AI search better than almost anyone. We have our own tracking product, ~25 million AI answers to analyze (with more tracked every week), and execution end-to-end: strategy, writing, in-house design, optimization, and performance reporting.

Marketing teams everywhere are working out what AI search means for them, and we're one of the few firms with credible answers backed by work we've already done. That's taking us beyond B2B tech scale-ups into conversations with global retailers, banks, and consumer brands, and into work well beyond search: positioning, websites, and how buyers choose between suppliers.

As Strategy Lead, you'll decide what work we do for every client, and why, and shape how our latest research on AI Search feeds into this decision. You'll run the Strategy team, set the strategy for our biggest accounts yourself, and build a strategy service that holds its quality as we take on much larger projects.

What you'll own

You'll own strategy across Ellipsis: what we recommend for each client, in what order, and why. You’ll ensure that all work we do for clients is adapted based on our constantly growing understanding of AI Search. You'll report directly to the MD/Founder and sit on the leadership team alongside the Accounts Lead, Head of Operations, and Chief of Staff.

Ellipsis is at the forefront of demand as SEO turns into GEO. We are growing very quickly as buyers are deciding now whom to trust with AI search, and some are bringing us in at board level as part of their AI strategy. The firms that earn those relationships over the next year will be hard to replace.

Our view is that AI makes yesterday's expertise cheap, so the job is to keep producing today's expertise and applying it well. Every client project should teach us more about what works, and that learning should make the next project faster and better. You’ll work closely with our Research and Development analyst to shape overall strategy, work with the team to ensure this is effectively used in practice, and ensure we have an effective feedback loop of findings <> implementation <> upskilling the team to ask better questions <> identifying gaps and new research.

Your job is to provide strategic judgement and ensure work gets done across the whole team. We have more data, tooling and ideas than any single client needs! And so your role will be identifying the leverage points across our customers; what can be done that makes performance better across the board? How can we deliver more of what our clients need? How can we build or improve automations that help us deliver more value? How do we apply findings, data, and research that actually lands?

You will own a couple of (high level or at risk – depending where you are most needed) clients and will need to be comfortable presenting, answering hard questions from clients, and building trust with our customers. You’ll need to be doing client work in order to understand how we do Strategy, what works, etc.; but client work is a max of 50% of the role.

You will work closely with other senior members of the team: our Accounts Lead owns client relationships, and you will need to collaborate closely; our Head of Operations owns capacity and process; our Founder&MD leads the business and is hands-on in the weeds with clients; and we’re currently hiring a Research and Development analyst to own the research (currently this is split across the team). You’ll also need to work closely with our Writing team and Content team to ensure questions are answered, strategy is understood, and everyone is doing the right work!

You will lead and line manage our Strategy team (currently 3); their personal development and progression is very important and you will have the chance to shape their up-skilling and growth! Search is changing quickly, and you’ll help our ambitious team progress rapidly.

How we'll measure it

We want to see progress in the key metrics we and our clients care about across the board – clients recommended, and picked, more often on the buying questions that matter to them, and that showing up in their pipeline. Alongside it, we want to see progress in the whole Strategy team's output: more clients and larger programmes carried by the same people, without quality slipping, and progress / progression for the team members too. Our understanding of AI Search continues to develop, and you’ll be instrumental in ensuring the work we do for clients adapts quickly to our latest research.

You'll see it working day to day! Every client has a plan they can explain in a sentence! Work lands when we said it would! Strategists spend most of their week doing strategy instead of preparing for meetings about it. And client calls never need the founder to step in to answer a question or rescue a number.

What you will do

Decide the work for every client. You own the plan for each account: what we do month on month, what we don't, and why. We have far more data and tooling than any one client needs, so most of your value is in choosing / discerning the two or three things that will move the result and saying no to the rest. You’ll need to be confident in understanding industry shifts and our latest research, and feeding that into the work we do for clients.

Make strategy simple. Turn complicated analysis into a recommendation a client, a Content Manager or a writer can act on first time, without coming back to you. Lead with the answer, and caveat only when it changes the decision. A one-page plan the client agrees with beats a 40-slide deck they have to decode.

Front strategy on the biggest accounts. You set the strategy for a handful of our largest, most complex accounts yourself and present it on calls with the Accounts Lead. You know the numbers, you answer the hard questions in the room, and can confidently and clearly present to senior stakeholders.

You'll need to be effective on these calls from your first few weeks. As the team grows, you'll do less of this day-to-day, but you'll still step in confidently whenever a client needs you.

Build strategy that scales to enterprise. Our newer projects span several markets and, in some cases, several brands. You design strategy that holds up across all of them: one approach per portfolio, adapted locally, with quality checks that don't depend on one senior person reading everything.

Take strategy closer to the sale. Clients increasingly bring us into positioning, website decisions and commercial performance reviews. Point our strategy at the decisions that move pipeline, using what buyers ask AI and what clients' sales teams hear to shape what clients say about themselves.

Run the Strategy team. You lead and develop a small, growing team of strategists, and upskill them so they can handle accounts at your level. You review their plans before clients see them, coach their judgment, and protect their time. You make it easy for them to ask for help early, and you notice when they haven't. Their progression is extremely important.

Plan to capacity. Our tooling generates more good ideas than any team can deliver. You make sure the plan fits the hours, working with Operations so what we promise each client is what Content, Writing and Design can ship on time. When something has to slip, you decide what and say so early.

Own our playbook and how we measure it. AI search changes weekly. You decide which new findings change how we work, update the playbook, and get the team using it. You also work with our Account Lead to define success for clients -- which questions count, what counts as a recommendation, how we weight them -- so every number in a client report means something commercially.

Shape what our tooling and agents do. Ellipsis builds its own AI search technology, and more of our delivery is moving to agents. You decide which strategy work they take on, check their output is right, and feed that back to our tech team, who build it. They own the tooling; you shape what it does for strategy.

Back up sales. Give our sales team a sharp strategic view on prospects quickly: what they need and what we'd do first. A clear view early in the process is often what wins the work.

Who we're looking for

You've led strategy for a portfolio of client accounts and managed strategists doing the same. In UK agencies this is typically a Head of SEO, SEO Director or Strategy Director, with 6-10 years in organic search and at least two of those managing people. Experience with enterprise or multi-market clients is a strong advantage. We're open to other routes if you can show the judgment.

You'll need a strong grasp of organic search fundamentals and a working understanding of AI search. We'll teach you how we think about AI search; we can't teach judgment. That means making a clear call from imperfect data, defending it calmly, and changing it when the evidence says so.

This is very much a client facing role. You will be expected to interact with the clients in tandem with the Accounts Lead regularly in meetings. Having experience handling strategic conversations, managing high level discussions and presentations with clients, from junior to C-suite is essential to your success.

We'll be looking hard for six things:

  • You simplify. You can explain a client's strategy in one sentence and defend it for ten minutes. Your decks got shorter as you got more senior.

  • Your priorities hold. You decide what matters this week, it stays decided, and when something will slip you say so before anyone has to ask.

  • You take feedback without ego. When you're wrong, you change course. At Ellipsis, continuous improvement matters more than being right! Especially as so much is changing now.

  • You use AI for speed, not slop or sprawl. You use Claude or ChatGPT daily, and you know the difference between work AI made faster and work AI just made bigger.

  • You want to drive things forward. You'd rather design a strategy service that works for 50 clients than be the hero on five.

  • You're a doer. You'd rather get the right work live for a client than spend a week building a tool to do it, and you're at your best in the room, with clients and with your team.

First 3 months

Shadow the Founder and the Accounts Lead on the main accounts, review strategy, data, etc and see how we work; and meet each strategist one-to-one. Get up to speed over the first month, and be effective on client calls for those accounts from early on.

By day 60, you're presenting strategy on those accounts, and every client plan is sized against the team's real capacity. By day 90, you own client strategy across the business, plans land on time, you've started building a way of working that lets the team carry more clients, strategists need you less on their accounts, and the founder joins strategy calls by exception only.

By six months, you're hitting your stride: adapting the work we do for clients as our understanding of AI Search changes, with less of your week spent on day-to-day client strategy.

How we'll test for this

The paid test project gives you a real, anonymized client dataset and asks for a one-page plan for the next quarter. We're testing what you choose and what you leave out, so a longer answer won't score better. In the follow-up interview we'll give you direct feedback on it, and how you respond is part of the assessment.

Compensation

£60k-£65k; which we expect to review after 6-12 months.

Benefits and application process

  • This is a full-time, 100% remote role (UK/EU based). You'll be a full team member, involved in our team projects, work and meetups.

  • We have a lot of clients in the US, so you'll need to be available for client and new business calls in the 5-7pm UK slot a couple of days a week.

  • Pension benchmarked to UK rates.

  • 28 days of paid holiday, plus 1 extra day a year with each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 5 additional days.

  • 4-day work week, once a month (instead of local bank holidays).

  • Flexible working, within the meeting schedule above.

  • Regular team retreats (~1 per year); the last was Istanbul, and before that Edinburgh, Oxford, Madrid and Budapest.

  • Time and budget for learning and development.

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave and sick pay.

It's important we find the best candidate for this position, and our selection process will reflect this. You'll have at least three video interviews, including with the Founder and members of the leadership team, and carry out the paid test project described above before we make an offer. After the test project, we'll ask for references from your previous two managers, and ask you to introduce us to them for a 10-minute call.

Much of our company Wiki is externally accessible, and you're encouraged to read through it before applying. We have a very useful guide to our interview process. It tells you what we're looking for, and reading it will make a real difference to your chances!

Please apply through Workable: apply.workable.com/getellipsis. We'll decide who progresses based on the form you submit, your cover letter and your CV, so please give us a good reason to select you. Taking the time to research the role, what we do and what you can do for us will increase your chance of success. Your cover letter is where you have the space to do this.

Whilst we love AI and sit at the leading edge of its adoption, we want to hear from you rather than from ChatGPT. For this role especially, your application is where we want to see how you think, in your own words.

We are hoping to fill this role by Christmas, so will review applications and start interviews on a rolling basis from the start of December. Applications will then close at the end of the day on Friday 11 December.

We do great work for clients and are building an ethical business that lets everyone do their best work. If you think you could be the next person to join our team, please apply!

Ellipsis is an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ellipsis-strategy-lead-remote-uk-eu-60-65k

item.title: Driversnote: Customer Support Specialist, 30 hrs
item.description:
Headquarters: Copenhagen
URL: https://www.driversnote.com/

About Driversnote

Driversnote is a profitable, product-led SaaS company based in Copenhagen that helps over 4.5 million users simplify mileage tracking, with paying customers in 100+ countries. Our core product is a freemium mobile app, often paired with our iBeacon hardware for precise, automated mileage logging, and backed by a powerful web platform.

We’re a close-knit team of 50 working together across design, mobile and web development, marketing, support, sales and customer success. We’ve quadrupled our ARR in the last three years by staying focused on delivering real value to our users, and we’re now expanding from B2C into B2B, building advanced features for teams.

Our Customer Success and Support team is locally anchored in Denmark, Canada and Australia. Customers get help in their own time zone from people who know their market, its rules and how its businesses work.

The role

As Customer Support Specialist, you’re the person our North American users and business customers reach when they need help. You solve their problem, explain it clearly and leave them more confident using Driversnote.

AI already answers many of our simpler questions. That means your time goes to the tickets where a person makes the difference: tracking issues, account and billing questions, and teams setting up for their drivers.

Success looks like this after your first six months:

  • Customers rate your replies highly, and you reply fast within your hours
  • You’re the go-to person in your time zone for questions about tracking and our iBeacon
  • You spot when a support question is really a team that’s ready to grow, and pass it on
  • You’ve used AI to improve at least one support process, making it faster, smoother or more helpful for customers

A typical workday

  • Helping customers by email, chat and phone
  • Working alongside our AI assistant: checking its answers, stepping in where a person is needed and flagging what it should learn
  • Reaching out to users whose company could benefit from Driversnote, and talking through how it could work for their team
  • Handling a steady flow of enquiries, with busy peaks like month-end when reports are due
  • Guiding users and team admins through the app and our web platform
  • Troubleshooting tracking issues and explaining the fix in a clear, friendly way
  • Sharing what you learn with the team and helping each other out across time zones

The pace can be high, so you stay focused, keep an overview and give every customer a good experience, even when several need you at once.

What you’ll do

  • Answer customers: Help customers by email, chat and phone for individual users and business teams.
  • Troubleshoot: Help customers get the most out of automatic tracking, using app diagnostics, and explain any settings to check in plain words.
  • Help business customers: Support admins and drivers on teams, and escalate to our Customer Success Managers when needed.
  • Spot growth: Notice when an individual user’s company could benefit from Driversnote for Teams, and pass them on.
  • Make the AI better: Review AI answers, flag gaps and help keep our help center accurate.
  • Share what you hear: Report bugs and feedback to Product and the mobile team.
  • Get hands-on with new business areas, such as checking drivers’ insurance documents for business customers.

What we’re looking for

  • Based in Canada, with the right to work here
  • 1+ years in customer support, ideally for an app or SaaS product
  • Near-native English, written and spoken
  • You write clearly and kindly, and can explain complex things in simple words
  • You’re comfortable troubleshooting: reproducing issues, asking good follow-up questions and narrowing down the real cause
  • You take ownership. You don’t drop threads, and you keep customers updated until the issue is solved
  • You can work without a perfect playbook. When something is unclear, you ask, figure it out and help improve the process for next time
  • You’re organised. You keep cases and handoffs clear, and help turn repeat questions into saved replies or clearer help articles
  • You stay calm under pressure and handle frustrated customers with care
  • Comfortable with tools like Help Scout, Stripe, Hubspot, and curious about AI
  • Able to work independently from home, with a reliable internet connection
  • Happy working alone much of the day. Your teammates are spread across Canada, Denmark and Australia, so you’re comfortable making decisions on your own and staying connected online
  • Available for the occasional early morning or late evening call with teammates in Denmark and Australia

Nice to have

  • French, written and spoken
  • Experience supporting business customers or admins
  • Knowledge of mileage reimbursement, tax or payroll

What we offer

  • $32 CAD / hour
  • Flexibility: fully remote, 30 hours a week.
  • A real team, across time zones: colleagues in Canada, Denmark and Australia, with regular calls to stay connected.
  • A week in Copenhagen: we fly you to Denmark for a week within your first year for training and to meet the team in person.
  • Health benefits: you’re employed through our employment partner, with health benefits included.
  • People to learn from: a team of highly experienced entrepreneurs and tech people.

We review applications and respond to candidates on an ongoing basis, until we’ve found the right fit. Expect a short case during the process: it reflects the kind of work you’ll do with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Ideal start date: January 2027

Please apply through our application which you can find on our website.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/driversnote-customer-support-specialist-30-hrs

item.title: Dropbox: Backend Product Software Engineer
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Mexico

Role Description

As a Product Engineer at Dropbox, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of collaboration and file sharing. Your responsibilities will revolve around developing and enhancing our suite of Dropbox Products to deliver exceptional user experiences. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, turning innovative ideas into robust, scalable, and user-friendly features.

This year, Dropbox is on a mission to expedite the creation and implementation of AI-enabled products by providing a comprehensive technology stack that facilitates rapid prototyping and reliable deployment of AI-augmented functionality.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Designing and building scalable software to reach millions of daily users.
  • Collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and analysts to understand user needs and develop products that meet those needs.
  • Developing and executing short and long-term roadmaps, balancing business impact, user experience, and technical quality.
  • Actively contributing to our team and company culture through mentorship, participation in interviews, and involvement in new initiatives.
  • Supporting fellow engineers through feedback, code reviews, and improvement of internal tools and processes.

On-call work may be necessary occasionally to help address bugs, outages, or other operational issues, with the goal of maintaining a stable and high-quality experience for our customers.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering or related industry roles.
  • BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e.g., physics or mathematics), or equivalent technical experience.
  • Demonstrated success in developing and deploying large-scale web applications with a user-focused approach.
  • Proficiency in building user-facing software and supporting web/desktop systems and libraries.
  • Ability to handle full-stack projects and deliver minimum viable products efficiently.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations if required by the team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contributions to open source projects or technical communities
  • Full-Stack Development
  • Technologies:  Python, Go, Java, Rust, MySQL

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/dropbox-backend-product-software-engineer-1
